title: Review Scrapers: Etsy, Shopee, Trustpilot, TikTok Shop
metaDescription: Scrape product reviews and store data from Etsy, Shopee, TikTok Shop, Trustpilot, DoorDash and Product Hunt: ratings, text, prices and sellers.
intro: Collect what customers say and what sellers charge. These scrapers return reviews with star ratings and text, product listings with prices, and shop or store details, ready for analysis.
